body:
Bonjour,
We are based in France but please reply in English. We are interested in your products and would like to receive more details.
Regards,
Jean,
France
reply:
Dear Jean,

Thank you for your interest in our products. However, given the current circumstances regarding our compliance policies, we cannot proceed with your request without additional verification.

If you can provide more information about your company and its operations, it would help us assist you further.

Xian Diao
DIOX Ltd.
